meta.title: Frankencoin for exchanges and wallets: list ZCHF, earn on savings
meta.description: List the decentralized Swiss franc, add one-tap savings and earn up to 25% of your users' interest through the referral contract.

hero.title: Give your users the Swiss franc.|Earn on it.
hero.subtitle: ZCHF is a standard token on eight chains with deep on-chain liquidity. Add savings to your wallet and earn up to 25% of the interest your users collect.

items.title: A non-USD stablecoin
items.description: The largest decentralized Swiss franc stablecoin, live since 2023 without a significant depeg.

items.title: Revenue share
items.description: Set your address as referrer when users save and receive up to 25% of their interest, paid by the contract.

items.title: Liquidity
items.description: Curve and Uniswap pools, DEX aggregators and regulated fiat ramps for size.

items.title: Eight chains
items.description: Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Gnosis, Avalanche and Sonic, bridged with Chainlink CCIP.

items.title: List the token
items.body: Standard ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Addresses per chain, logos and supply endpoints are public.

items.title: Add savings
items.body: Call the savings contract with your referrer address and fee. Users keep full control and can remove the referrer.

items.title: Tell your users
items.body: Use the press kit and live figures. We are happy to co-announce.

items.title: Protocol figures
items.description: Supply per chain, collateral and reserve as JSON.

cta.title: Listing ZCHF?
cta.body: The association supports listings with liquidity introductions, co-marketing and technical help.
